raw_text: PSA: The atrocity videos circulating about Kashmir today are fabricated. I ran reverse image searches and the footage is from the Syrian civil war and Myanmar's Rakhine state. The audio has been dubbed over in Kashmiri dialect and all EXIF metadata has been stripped. This happens every year around August 5. Pakistani accounts mass-produce these fake videos to coincide with the Article 370 anniversary. Don't fall for it.
clean_text: Reddit users debunked Kashmir atrocity videos as fabricated from Syrian and Myanmar footage. Audio dubbed in Kashmiri dialect with metadata stripped. Pattern repeats annually around Article 370 anniversary.
